SELECT id, text FROM reviews
   WHERE analyzed = false
   ORDER BY review_date DESC
   LIMIT 200;

WITH data AS (SELECT $q${{ JSON.stringify($json) }}$q$::jsonb AS d),
upd AS (
  UPDATE reviews r
  SET service = x.service, text_en = x.text_en, analyzed = true
  FROM jsonb_to_recordset((SELECT d->'reviews' FROM data))
       AS x(id text, service text, text_en text)
  WHERE r.id = x.id
  RETURNING r.id
)
INSERT INTO review_issues (review_id, label, category, severity, is_new)
SELECT review_id, label, category, severity, is_new
FROM jsonb_to_recordset((SELECT d->'issues' FROM data))
     AS y(review_id text, label text, category text, severity int, is_new boolean)
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
